predictions.source_summary: address, roomId, and sender come directly from HTTP request parameters (request.args). No validation beyond checking medium == 'email' and checking for existing MXID binding.
predictions.sink_summary: SMTP sendmail via sendEmail function: reads template file, performs string formatting with % operator, sends email to parsed address.
predictions.guard_summary: 1. require_args ensures required parameters present. 2. Check for existing MXID binding prevents invites for already-bound addresses. 3. Medium must be 'email'. No validation of email address format, no rate limiting, no authorization check that sender can invite to room.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled email address and template substitutions used in email sending without proper validation. Template formatting with % operator could allow format string attacks if template contains format specifiers and user data is improperly sanitized.
called_function_context: sendEmail(sydent, templateName, mailTo, substitutions) reads template file, performs % formatting, sends via SMTP
predictions.context_summary: HTTP POST handler for storing invite tokens and sending invitation emails. Validates medium is email and address not already bound. Sends email with room_id and sender substitutions.
